name: Vinho Verde Wine Quality
description: Physicochemical measurements and ordinal sensory quality scores for red and white wines.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Cortez, P. et al. (2009). Wine Quality [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C56S3T.

learning_goals: Compare RMSE, MAE, R², and residual diagnostics.
Inspect nonlinear effects and correlated chemistry measurements.
Discuss regression versus ordinal classification framing.
ethical_notes: Sensory quality is subjective and imbalanced; predictions are not a substitute for qualified tasting, quality assurance, or safety testing.
